address: via Chiesa 61, località Marzaglia, Modena, 41123, Italy
bio: This restaurant housed in an old watermill offers a taste of Puglia just outside Modena, where it serves typical specialities from this southern Italian region. The menu includes a vegetable-based antipasti buffet, superb home-made pastas, and main dishes that range from delicious baked vegetable pies to meat cooked over the barbecue grill. To finish, the desserts are served in a basket and feature a selection of sweet delicacies such as chocolate-covered dried fruit and nuts....
